name: Del Monte Canned Diced Potatoes in Water & Sea Salt
whyItWorks: Idaho russet potatoes peeled with 100% of skins removed, diced and cooked tender in water. Gentle pure starch that warms in 2 minutes, ready to mash or simmer in broth.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Drain, rinse, and heat in a saucepan with chicken bone broth and a touch of butter.
